wikiRules.poolRemoval: The original game consumes selected real and fake records across its three Wikis without duplicates; only45 of60 real sites appear in one new run. The complete-port layout must explicitly document its deterministic display choice.
wikiRules.secondWikiLink: One non-specific, non-HasWindow site selected for Wiki I receives HoldsSecondWikiLink. Wiki II and III are distinct host-generated Wiki records, not automatically ordinary listed pages.
wikiRules.portDisplay: For this complete collection, all60 sites are deterministically distributed across the three original Wiki templates (20 each), with10 distinct original fake links each. This deliberately replaces the original per-run random45-site subset so every site is reachable.

resourcePolicy.imagePolicy: All original existing image records are allowed except every image in the five withheld-context roots. No image decoding or pixel copying is permitted for blockedImagePaths.

excludedContent.transformationScope: Existing user-provided game assets; adult horror material is not blanket-excluded. Only sexual-minor and unresolved sexual-age contexts are withheld.
excludedContent.placeholderRule: Keep every original route reachable through a neutral clearly labeled unavailable placeholder; never copy withheld HTML bodies or associated images into the output.
